excerpt: JMG's Master's Programme in Investigative Journalism Do you want to learn more about investigative journalism and its possibilities? Together with other students from all over the world, you will have the opportunity to sharpen your knowledge for one year at JMG's international Master's Programme in Investigative Journalism, MIJ. The programme will give you a rich understanding of investigative journalism as a democratic phenomenon, the skills to conceive, design, conduct, deliver and publish effective journalistic investigations in today’s digital media environments. We focus on cross-border collaborative journalism, data journalism and investigative journalism methods. Read more about the MIJ Programme More information about programme structure and content, who should apply, prerequisites etc. here. See our students' investigations Many of the students have had their final projects in investigative journalism published in both Swedish and international media. You will find some examples here.
